pub type Raw
pub enum CommandClass
  Read
  Reveal
  Propose
  Edit
  Commit
  Destroy
  Spend
  Send
  pub const ALL: [Self; 8]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> ::std::option::Option<Self>
pub enum CommandOutcome
  Applied
  Proposed
  Accepted
  Conflict
  Stale
  Invalid
  Unsupported
  Forbidden
  NotPermitted
  Refused
  Exhausted
  NotFound
  Unknown
  Unavailable
  Failed
  pub const ALL: [Self; 15]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> ::std::option::Option<Self>
pub enum ReadingOutcome
  Page
  Gap
  Conflict
  Stale
  Invalid
  Unsupported
  NotPermitted
  Refused
  Exhausted
  NotFound
  Unavailable
  pub const ALL: [Self; 11]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> ::std::option::Option<Self>
pub enum FieldRole
  Ordinary
  Derived
  Ephemeral
  Secret
  pub const ALL: [Self; 4]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> ::std::option::Option<Self>
pub enum CollectionOp
  Add
  Remove
  Move
  Replace
  Reset
  pub const ALL: [Self; 5]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> ::std::option::Option<Self>
pub enum InvokeMode
  Propose
  Apply
  pub const ALL: [Self; 2]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> ::std::option::Option<Self>
pub mod reveal_style
  pub const HIGHLIGHT: &str
  pub const SCROLL_TO: &str
  pub const FRAME: &str
  pub const ALL: [&str; 3]
pub const VERSIONS: [&str; 1]
pub const EXTENSIONS: [&str; 4]
pub const BINDING_TOOLS: [&str; 7]
pub const GATEWAY_TOOLS: [&str; 4]
pub const META_KEYS: [&str; 2]
pub const COMMAND_ACTIONS: [&str; 8]
pub struct ContextRef
  instance: ::std::string::String
  context: ::std::string::String
  epoch: ::std::string::String
pub struct ContextEntry
  context: ContextRef
  title: ::std::string::String
  revision: ::std::string::String
pub struct ContextPage
  outcome: ReadingOutcome
  contexts: ::std::vec::Vec<ContextEntry>
  reason: ::std::string::String
pub struct KindField
  name: ::std::string::String
  role: FieldRole
pub struct Kind
  name: ::std::string::String
  title: ::std::string::String
  schema: Raw
  fields: ::std::vec::Vec<KindField>
pub struct Entity
  id: ::std::string::String
  kind: ::std::string::String
  label: ::std::string::String
  parent: ::std::string::String
  properties: Raw
pub struct Collection
  parent: ::std::string::String
  kind: ::std::string::String
  ids: ::std::vec::Vec<::std::string::String>
pub struct Selection
  view: ::std::string::String
  entities: ::std::vec::Vec<::std::string::String>
  focus: ::std::string::String
pub struct ContextSnapshot
  outcome: ReadingOutcome
  context: ContextRef
  revision: ::std::string::String
  entities: ::std::vec::Vec<Entity>
  collections: ::std::vec::Vec<Collection>
  selections: ::std::vec::Vec<Selection>
  cursor: ::std::string::String
  reason: ::std::string::String
pub struct ReadRequest
  context: ContextRef
  entities: ::std::vec::Vec<::std::string::String>
  cursor: ::std::string::String
  limit: i64
pub struct Change
  base_revision: ::std::string::String
  revision: ::std::string::String
  patch: Raw
pub struct ChangesRequest
  context: ContextRef
  after_revision: ::std::string::String
  wait_ms: i64
pub struct ChangeBatch
  outcome: ReadingOutcome
  context: ContextRef
  changes: ::std::vec::Vec<Change>
  revision: ::std::string::String
  reason: ::std::string::String
pub struct CommandSpec
  name: ::std::string::String
  title: ::std::string::String
  description: ::std::string::String
  class: CommandClass
  input_schema: Raw
  output_schema: Raw
  targets: ::std::vec::Vec<::std::string::String>
  proposable: bool
  undoable: bool
  idempotent: bool
  long_running: bool
pub struct ContextBounds
  snapshot_bytes: i64
  change_bytes: i64
  retained_revisions: i64
  pending_proposals: i64
  calls_in_flight: i64
pub struct Description
  version: ::std::string::String
  kinds: ::std::vec::Vec<Kind>
  commands: ::std::vec::Vec<CommandSpec>
  extensions: ::std::vec::Vec<::std::string::String>
  bounds: ContextBounds
pub struct DescriptionResult
  outcome: ReadingOutcome
  description: ::std::option::Option<Description>
  reason: ::std::string::String
pub struct Invocation
  context: ContextRef
  arguments: Raw
  mode: InvokeMode
  expected_revision: ::std::string::String
  idempotency_key: ::std::string::String
  proposal: ::std::string::String
pub struct CommandResult
  outcome: CommandOutcome
  reason: ::std::string::String
  revision: ::std::string::String
  proposal: ::std::string::String
  summary: ::std::string::String
  job: ::std::string::String
  effects: Raw
  undo_group: ::std::string::String
  idempotency_key: ::std::string::String
pub struct Reveal
  context: ContextRef
  entities: ::std::vec::Vec<::std::string::String>
  style: ::std::string::String
pub struct UndoRequest
  context: ContextRef
  undo_group: ::std::string::String
  expected_revision: ::std::string::String
  idempotency_key: ::std::string::String
pub struct JobRequest
  instance: ::std::string::String
  job: ::std::string::String
pub struct DeclaredCommand
  name: ::std::string::String
  class: CommandClass
pub struct CommandDeclaration
  version: ::std::string::String
  commands: ::std::vec::Vec<DeclaredCommand>
pub struct ApplicationsQuery
  application: ::std::string::String
pub struct ListedInstance
  instance: ::std::string::String
  interface: ::std::string::String
  contexts: ::std::vec::Vec<ContextEntry>
  reason: ::std::string::String
pub struct ListedApplication
  application: ::std::string::String
  title: ::std::string::String
  instances: ::std::vec::Vec<ListedInstance>
pub struct ListedOpenVerb
  name: ::std::string::String
  description: ::std::string::String
  input_schema: Raw
pub struct ApplicationOpenVerbs
  application: ::std::string::String
  verbs: ::std::vec::Vec<ListedOpenVerb>
pub struct ApplicationListing
  outcome: ReadingOutcome
  applications: ::std::vec::Vec<ListedApplication>
  reason: ::std::string::String
  open_verbs: ::std::vec::Vec<ApplicationOpenVerbs>
pub struct CommandsQuery
  application: ::std::string::String
  instance: ::std::string::String
pub struct CommandListing
  outcome: ReadingOutcome
  application: ::std::string::String
  instance: ::std::string::String
  commands: ::std::vec::Vec<CommandSpec>
  reason: ::std::string::String
pub struct GatewayCall
  application: ::std::string::String
  instance: ::std::string::String
  tool: ::std::string::String
  arguments: Raw
  mode: ::std::option::Option<InvokeMode>
  expected_revision: ::std::string::String
  idempotency_key: ::std::string::String
  context: ::std::string::String
  proposal: ::std::string::String
  require_read_permit: ::std::option::Option<bool>
pub struct CallRecord
  subject: ::std::string::String
  client_label: ::std::string::String
  application: ::std::string::String
  instance: ::std::string::String
  context: ::std::option::Option<ContextRef>
  command: ::std::string::String
  class: ::std::option::Option<CommandClass>
  revision_before: ::std::string::String
  revision_after: ::std::string::String
  outcome: ::std::string::String
  reason: ::std::string::String
  idempotency_key: ::std::string::String
  arguments_digest: ::std::string::String
  result_digest: ::std::string::String
pub struct Envelope
  description: ::std::option::Option<DescriptionResult>
  contexts: ::std::option::Option<ContextPage>
  read: ::std::option::Option<ReadRequest>
  snapshot: ::std::option::Option<ContextSnapshot>
  changes_request: ::std::option::Option<ChangesRequest>
  changes: ::std::option::Option<ChangeBatch>
  invocation: ::std::option::Option<Invocation>
  result: ::std::option::Option<CommandResult>
  reveal: ::std::option::Option<Reveal>
  undo: ::std::option::Option<UndoRequest>
  job: ::std::option::Option<JobRequest>
  declaration: ::std::option::Option<CommandDeclaration>
  record: ::std::option::Option<CallRecord>
  applications_query: ::std::option::Option<ApplicationsQuery>
  applications: ::std::option::Option<ApplicationListing>
  commands_query: ::std::option::Option<CommandsQuery>
  commands: ::std::option::Option<CommandListing>
  call: ::std::option::Option<GatewayCall>
pub fn encode(v: &Envelope) -> ::std::vec::Vec<u8>

  word: &'static str
  offset: usize
